About Turing: 
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Analyst to evaluate and compare responses generated by multiple chatbots. The role involves reviewing outputs against defined guidelines, identifying inaccuracies or quality issues, and providing a clear final assessment for each evaluation task.

 Key Responsibilities 
 • Evaluate and compare responses generated by multiple chatbots.
 • Assess responses for accuracy, relevance, completeness, clarity, and adherence to guidelines.
 • Identify errors, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential quality issues.
 • Provide structured feedback and final assessments for each task.
 • Follow evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across all reviews.
 • Document findings clearly and accurately.
 • Collaborate with project and quality teams to resolve queries.
 • Meet assigned productivity, quality, and turnaround-time targets.
 • Escalate complex or ambiguous cases when necessary.
 Required Qualifications 
 • Experience in Quality Assurance, data annotation, content evaluation, testing, or a similar role.
 • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 • High attention to detail and ability to identify subtle errors.
 • Comfortable working with AI tools, chatbots, and online platforms.
 • Prior experience with chatbot evaluation, LLM testing, or data-quality projects is an advantage.
 Perks of Freelancing With Turing: 
 • Work at the forefront of AI applications in accounting and finance.
 • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
 • Opportunity to collaborate on high-impact projects with global reach.
 Offer Details: 
 • This is a project-based role involving a defined number of evaluation tasks.
 • Each task will involve comparing multiple chatbots and providing a final assessment.
 • Work Schedule: Five working days per week, including weekends as required, with two weekdays off.
 • Duration: 16 weeks.
